caption: The drawing depicts a clown costume design shown from both the back and front, along with two separate illustrations of the clown’s head—one in frontal view and one in side view. The costume consists of a loose, light-colored, polka-dotted garment with blue and green circles, gathered at the waist, wrists, and knees, which are finished with red zigzag trim. The cuffs, collar, and hem are accented with red ruffles. The shoes are pointed and brown, with stockings featuring horizontal pastel stripes. The clown's head features exaggerated makeup, including a white face, red cheeks, a wide red mouth, and black-painted eyebrows. The hair is styled in three large, bushy black tufts sticking out in different directions. The head is shown both attached to the costume and separately in two views, emphasizing the design details. The drawing is done on a cream-colored paper with colored ink and watercolor, using predominantly light blues, reds, greens, browns, black, and white.
title: Puppet - "Clown on a Tear"
